title: C2 yakuniy imtihon va sertifikat
goal_uz: Dars oxirida C2 darajasining butun materialini (grammatika, lug‘at, talaffuz va to‘rt ko‘nikma) vaqt bilan mashq qilib takrorlaysiz, imtihon strategiyasini qo‘llaysiz va 15 savolli yakuniy testga tayyor bo‘lasiz.

scenes.title: Yakuniy imtihon darsiga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Bu C2 darajasining oxirgi darsi, ya’ni butun kursning yakuniy darsi. Oldingi darsda imtihon kuni strategiyasi va ruhiy tayyorgarlikni ko‘rib chiqdik. Bugun butun darajani tartib bilan takrorlaymiz: grammatika, lug‘at, talaffuz, o‘qish, tinglash, yozish va gapirish.
scenes.say: Welcome to the final lesson of the course. Last time we talked about exam-day strategy and psychology. Today we review the whole of C2, practise against the clock, and finish with a fifteen-question exam.
scenes.say_uz: Kursning yakuniy darsiga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar imtihon kuni strategiyasi va psixologiyasi haqida gaplashdik. Bugun butun C2 darajasini takrorlaymiz, vaqt bilan mashq qilamiz va o‘n beshta savolli imtihon bilan yakunlaymiz.

scenes.title: Bugungi reja va sertifikat talablari
scenes.say_native: Reja oddiy. Avval strategiya, keyin grammatika, lug‘at va talaffuz, so‘ng o‘qish, tinglash, yozish va gapirish. Sertifikat olish uchun yakuniy imtihon testini topshirasiz va platformada ko‘rsatilgan o‘tish talabini bajarasiz. Muhimi shuki, imtihon yangi narsani so‘ramaydi: u siz yuzlab soat o‘rgangan narsani tekshiradi.
scenes.say: Here is the plan. Strategy first, then grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation, then the four skills. To earn your certificate you must pass the final exam test. Remember: an exam does not ask for anything new. It checks what you already know.
scenes.say_uz: Reja shunday. Avval strategiya, keyin grammatika, lug‘at va talaffuz, so‘ng to‘rt ko‘nikma. Sertifikat uchun yakuniy imtihon testidan o‘tishingiz kerak. Esda tuting: imtihon yangi narsa so‘ramaydi, bilganingizni tekshiradi.

scenes.title: Strategiya: vaqt va savolni o‘qish

examples.t: Read the task twice before you answer.
examples.uz: Javob berishdan oldin topshiriqni ikki marta o‘qing.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi qoida: savolni avval o‘qing, matnni keyin. Savoldagi kalit so‘zlarning tagiga chizing: “not”, “except”, “most likely”, “writer’s attitude”. Ko‘pchilik o‘zbek tilida o‘ylab, savolning yarmini o‘qiydi va noto‘g‘ri javob beradi. Ikkinchi qoida: vaqtni oldindan bo‘ling.
scenes.say: Read the question before the text, and underline the key words, such as not, except, or most likely. Divide your time in advance. If one item is stubborn, mark it and move on. Keep the last few minutes for checking.
scenes.say_uz: Matndan oldin savolni o‘qing, kalit so‘zlarning tagiga chizing. Vaqtni oldindan bo‘ling. Qiyin savolni belgilab, keyingisiga o‘ting. Oxirgi daqiqalarni tekshirishga qoldiring.

scenes.title: Grammatika: zamon va aspekt

examples.t: I have lived here since 2019.
By the time we arrived, it had started.
examples.uz: Biz yetib borganimizda u boshlanib bo‘lgan edi.

examples.t: This time tomorrow I will be flying.
examples.uz: Ertaga shu vaqtda men uchib ketayotgan bo‘laman.

scenes.say_native: Zamon va aspekt tizimi C2 imtihonining yuragi. Present perfect hozirgi paytga bog‘langan: “since 2019” bilan doim perfect keladi. Past perfect ikki o‘tgan voqeadan avvalgisini ko‘rsatadi. Continuous shakl jarayonni yoki vaqtinchalik holatni bildiradi.
scenes.say: Present perfect links the past to now, so since and for call for it. Past perfect marks the earlier of two past events. A continuous form shows an action in progress or a temporary situation.
scenes.say_uz: Present perfect o‘tmishni hozirga bog‘laydi, shuning uchun since va for u bilan keladi. Past perfect ikki o‘tgan voqeadan avvalgisini bildiradi. Continuous jarayon yoki vaqtinchalik holatni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Xato: since bilan oddiy hozirgi zamon
board: ✓ I have been living here since 2019.
scenes.say_native: Bu o‘zbek tilidan o‘tadigan eng mashhur xato. Biz “2019-yildan beri yashayman” deymiz, chunki o‘zbekchada hozirgi zamon shakli yetarli. Inglizchada esa davom etayotgan holat o‘tmishdan hozirgacha cho‘ziladi va buni present perfect ko‘rsatadi. “Live” bilan oddiy ham, continuous ham to‘g‘ri, ma’no deyarli bir xil.
scenes.say: Not: I live here since 2019. Say: I have lived here since 2019, or I have been living here since 2019. Whenever you see since or for with a continuing situation, check for the perfect.
scenes.say_uz: Emas: I live here since 2019. To‘g‘risi: I have lived yoki I have been living here since 2019. Davom etayotgan holat bilan since yoki for ko‘rsangiz, perfectni tekshiring.

scenes.title: Vaqtli mashq: zamonlar
board: 2 The film ___ (already start) when we arrived.
scenes.say_native: Endi vaqt bilan mashq. Har bir gapda qavs ichidagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri shaklga qo‘ying. Har gapga yarim daqiqadan kam vaqt ajrating. Birinchi gapda “since”, ikkinchisida “when we arrived”, uchinchisida “this time tomorrow”, to‘rtinchisida “wish” so‘ziga e’tibor bering. Javoblarni keyingi bosqichda tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Put each verb in brackets into the correct form. Look at the signal words: since, when we arrived, this time tomorrow, and wish. You have a few seconds for each one. Go.
scenes.say_uz: Qavs ichidagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri shaklga qo‘ying. Signal so‘zlarga qarang: since, when we arrived, this time tomorrow va wish. Boshladik.

scenes.title: Javoblar: zamonlar

examples.t: I wish I knew the answer.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “has worked” yoki “has been working”, sababi “since 2018”. Ikkinchi: “had already started”, chunki film biz kelishimizdan oldin boshlangan. Uchinchi: “will be flying”, ya’ni ertaga shu paytda jarayon ichida bo‘lamiz. To‘rtinchi: “knew”. “Wish” hozirgi paytdagi afsus uchun o‘tgan zamon shaklini talab qiladi: bilmayman, shuning uchun “bilsam edi”.
scenes.say: One: has worked or has been working. Two: had already started. Three: will be flying. Four: knew. A wish about the present takes the past form: I wish I knew.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: has worked yoki has been working. Ikki: had already started. Uch: will be flying. To‘rt: knew. Hozirgi paytga oid wish o‘tgan zamon shaklini oladi.

scenes.title: Artikllar: takrorlash
board: an hour, a university, an MBA

examples.t: She is an honest woman.
The elderly need support.
He plays the guitar.
I love music.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘q, shuning uchun bu mavzu hamma uchun qiyin. Qoidalarni qisqa eslaymiz. Birinchi marta aytilgan, ixtiyoriy narsaga “a” yoki “an”. Aniq yoki yagona narsaga “the”. Umumiy ma’nodagi ko‘plik va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan artikl yo‘q.
scenes.say: Use a or an for something mentioned for the first time. Use the for something specific or unique. Use no article for general plurals and uncountable nouns. Choose a or an by sound: an hour, a university. And the plus an adjective names a whole group: the elderly.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi marta aytilgan narsaga a yoki an. Aniq yoki yagona narsaga the. Umumiy ko‘plik va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan artikl yo‘q. A yoki an ni tovushga qarab tanlang. The plus sifat butun guruhni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Vaqtli mashq: artikllar
scenes.say_native: Artikl mashqi. Bo‘sh joyga “a”, “an”, “the” yoki nol artikl qo‘ying. Birinchi gapda so‘zning tovushiga qarang. Ikkinchisida sifat butun guruhni bildiryapti. Uchinchisida cholg‘u asbobi, to‘rtinchisida umumiy ma’nodagi musiqa. O‘ylang va javobni ichingizda ayting.
scenes.say: Fill each gap with a, an, the, or no article. Listen for the first sound in sentence one. Sentence two names a group. Three is an instrument. Four is music in general.
scenes.say_uz: Bo‘sh joylarga a, an, the yoki nol artikl qo‘ying. Birinchida tovushga, ikkinchida guruhga, uchinchida cholg‘uga, to‘rtinchida umumiy musiqaga e’tibor bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: artikllar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “an honest woman”, chunki “honest” undosh bilan yozilsa ham unli tovush bilan boshlanadi, h aytilmaydi. Ikkinchi: “The unemployed”, ya’ni ishsizlar guruhi. Uchinchi: “plays the guitar”, cholg‘u asboblari bilan “the” ishlatiladi. To‘rtinchi: “I love music”, umumiy ma’noda artikl kerak emas.
scenes.say: One: an, because honest begins with a vowel sound. Two: The, for the group of unemployed people. Three: the, with instruments. Four: no article, because music is general.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: an, chunki honest unli tovush bilan boshlanadi. Ikki: The, ishsizlar guruhi. Uch: the, cholg‘u bilan. To‘rt: artikl yo‘q, chunki musiqa umumiy ma’noda.

scenes.title: Inversiya, cleft va subjunktiv
board: Never have I seen such a view.
Not only did he lie, but he also stole.
Were I to resign, … / It was the noise that woke me.
I suggest (that) he see a doctor.

examples.t: Rarely do we get such chances.
Hardly had I arrived when it rained.

scenes.say_native: C2 darajasining belgisi bu murakkab tuzilmalar. Inkor yoki cheklovchi ibora gap boshiga chiqsa, yordamchi fe’l subyektdan oldin keladi: “Never have I seen”, “Rarely do we get”. Shartda “if” ni tushirib, “Were I to resign” deyish mumkin. Cleft gap “It was the noise that woke me” urg‘uni bitta bo‘lakka qaratadi.
scenes.say: With a negative or limiting adverbial at the start, the auxiliary comes before the subject: Never have I seen, Rarely do we get. We can drop if: Were I to resign. A cleft sentence such as It was the noise that woke me puts focus on one part. After suggest that, use the base form.
scenes.say_uz: Inkor yoki cheklovchi ibora gap boshida bo‘lsa, yordamchi fe’l subyektdan oldin keladi. If ni tushirib, Were I to resign deyish mumkin. Cleft gap bitta bo‘lakka urg‘u beradi. Suggest that dan keyin fe’lning oddiy shakli keladi.

scenes.title: Xato: inversiyada to‘g‘ri so‘z tartibi
board: ✗ Never I have seen such a view.
✓ Never have I seen such a view.
✓ Not only did he lie, but …
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “Hech qachon bunday manzarani ko‘rmaganman” deymiz va so‘z tartibi bir xil qoladi. Shuning uchun inglizcha “Never I have seen” deb yuborasiz. Esda tuting: gap boshidagi inkor so‘zdan keyin savol tartibi ishlaydi, ya’ni yordamchi fe’l, so‘ng subyekt.
scenes.say: Not: Never I have seen. Say: Never have I seen. After the fronted negative, use question word order. If there is no auxiliary, add do, does or did, and the main verb returns to the base form.
scenes.say_uz: Emas: Never I have seen. To‘g‘risi: Never have I seen. Inkor gap boshida bo‘lsa, savol tartibi ishlaydi. Yordamchi fe’l bo‘lmasa, do, does yoki did qo‘shiladi.

scenes.title: Vaqtli mashq: gapni qayta yozing
board: 1 I have never seen such a view. → Never …
2 If I were to leave, … → … I to leave, …
3 He lied and he also stole. → Not only …
4 We rarely get such chances. → Rarely …
scenes.say_native: Gaplarni berilgan boshlanishdan davom ettirib qayta yozing. Birinchida “have” subyektdan oldin turadi. Ikkinchida “if” tushib qoladi. Uchinchi va to‘rtinchida yordamchi fe’lni unutmang: “did” va “do”. Har gapga taxminan o‘n soniya. Javobni og‘zaki ayting.
scenes.say: Rewrite each sentence starting with the words given. In one, have goes before the subject. In two, if disappears. In three and four, remember did and do. Say your answers aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni berilgan so‘zlardan boshlab qayta yozing. Birinchida have subyektdan oldin, ikkinchida if tushadi, uchinchi va to‘rtinchida did va do kerak. Javobni ovoz chiqarib ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: qayta yozish
board: 1 Never have I seen such a view.
3 Not only did he lie, but he also stole.
4 Rarely do we get such chances.
scenes.say_native: Tekshiramiz. Birinchi: “Never have I seen such a view.” Ikkinchi: “Were I to leave”, ya’ni “if” yo‘q, “were” gap boshida. Uchinchi: “Not only did he lie, but he also stole”, “did” bor, “lie” esa oddiy shaklda. To‘rtinchi: “Rarely do we get such chances.” Bu tuzilmalar rasmiy yozuvda va og‘zaki nutqda ham fikringizga vazn beradi.
scenes.say: One: Never have I seen such a view. Two: Were I to leave. Three: Not only did he lie, but he also stole. Four: Rarely do we get such chances. These structures give weight to formal speech and writing.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Never have I seen such a view. Ikki: Were I to leave. Uch: Not only did he lie, but he also stole. To‘rt: Rarely do we get such chances. Bu tuzilmalar nutqingizga vazn beradi.

scenes.title: Frazali fe’llar va noto‘g‘ri fe’llar
board: lie – lay – lain / lay – laid – laid
rise – rose – risen / raise – raised – raised

examples.t: I can’t put up with this noise.
The deal fell through.
Prices have risen sharply.

scenes.say_native: Frazali fe’llar ma’nosini qismlaridan chiqarib bo‘lmaydi, ularni butun holda yodlash kerak: “put up with” chidamoq, “fall through” barbod bo‘lmoq, “come up with” o‘ylab topmoq. Noto‘g‘ri fe’llarda juftliklarga ehtiyot bo‘ling. “Lie” yotmoq: lie, lay, lain, obyektsiz. “Lay” qo‘ymoq: lay, laid, laid, obyekt bilan.
scenes.say: Phrasal verbs must be learned as whole units: put up with, fall through, come up with. Watch the irregular pairs. Lie, lay, lain means to rest, with no object. Lay, laid, laid needs an object. Rise happens by itself; raise needs an object.
scenes.say_uz: Frazali fe’llarni butun holda yodlang. Noto‘g‘ri fe’l juftliklariga ehtiyot bo‘ling: lie, lay, lain obyektsiz; lay, laid, laid obyekt bilan. Rise o‘zi ko‘tarilish, raise esa ko‘tarishdir.

scenes.title: Xato: lay va lie, rise va raise
board: ✗ She lay the book on the table. (yesterday)
✓ She laid the book on the table.
✗ Prices have raised. ✓ Prices have risen.
scenes.say_native: Ona tilida bu farq yo‘q, shuning uchun xato qilish tabiiy. Qoida oddiy: obyekt bor-yo‘qligiga qarang. “Qo‘ymoq” obyekt talab qiladi: “She laid the book”. “Yotmoq” obyektsiz: “She lay on the sofa”. “Prices have risen” deymiz, chunki narxlar o‘zi ko‘tariladi. Lekin “The government has raised taxes” to‘g‘ri, chunki “taxes” obyekt.
scenes.say: Look for an object. Lay needs one: She laid the book on the table. Lie has none: She lay on the sofa. Prices have risen, because prices rise by themselves, but the government has raised taxes.
scenes.say_uz: Obyektga qarang. Lay obyekt talab qiladi, lie esa talab qilmaydi. Narxlar o‘zi ko‘tariladi: risen. Hukumat soliqlarni ko‘taradi: raised.

scenes.title: Vaqtli mashq: fe’llar
board: 1 I can’t ___ this noise any longer. (put up / put on)
2 The deal fell ___ at the last minute.
4 She ___ the keys on the desk. (lay / laid)
scenes.say_native: Fe’llar mashqi. Birinchida “chidamoq” ma’nosi kerak. Ikkinchida kelishuv barbod bo‘lgan. Uchinchida narxlar obyektsiz o‘zi ko‘tarilgan. To‘rtinchida “qo‘ymoq” fe’li o‘tgan zamonda. Har bir javobni tezda tanlang.
scenes.say: Choose the right verb or particle. One means tolerate. Two is a deal that failed. In three, prices act by themselves. In four, someone put the keys down in the past.
scenes.say_uz: To‘g‘ri fe’l yoki predlogni tanlang. Birinchisi chidamoq, ikkinchisi barbod bo‘lgan kelishuv, uchinchisida narxlar o‘zi ko‘tariladi, to‘rtinchisida kimdir kalitlarni qo‘ygan.

scenes.title: Javoblar: fe’llar
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “put up with”, chidamoq. “Put on” kiymoq degani, bu yerga sig‘maydi. Ikkinchi: “fell through”. Uchinchi: “risen”, chunki “narxlar” o‘zi ko‘tarilgan va obyekt yo‘q. To‘rtinchi: “laid”, chunki “keys” obyekt, o‘tgan zamon esa “laid”. Agar “lay” deb tanlagan bo‘lsangiz, bu fe’lning hozirgi zamon shakli.
scenes.say: One: put up with. Two: through. Three: risen. Four: laid, because keys is the object. If you chose lay, remember that is the present form.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: put up with. Ikki: through. Uch: risen. To‘rt: laid, chunki keys obyekt. Lay desangiz, bu hozirgi zamon shakli.

scenes.title: Lug‘at: nozik ma’no va ohang

examples.t: Painkillers alleviate the pain.
Heavy rain will exacerbate the flooding.

scenes.say_native: C2 lug‘atida asosiy qiyinchilik so‘zni emas, uning ohangini bilishda. “Alleviate” og‘riqni yoki muammoni yengillashtiradi, “exacerbate” esa yomonlashtiradi. Bular yaqin ko‘rinadi, lekin ma’nolari qarama-qarshi. “Coherent” mantiqan bog‘liq va tushunarli degani.
scenes.say: At C2, tone matters as much as meaning. Alleviate makes something less severe; exacerbate makes it worse. Coherent means logical and clear. And hedging, as in It would appear that, makes you sound confident but careful.
scenes.say_uz: C2 da ohang ma’no kabi muhim. Alleviate yengillashtiradi, exacerbate yomonlashtiradi. Coherent mantiqli va aniq degani. It would appear that kabi ehtiyotkor ifodalar ishonchli, lekin mag‘rur emas.

scenes.title: Vaqtli mashq: eng mos so‘z
board: 1 Rising sea levels will ___ the risk of flooding.
4 “It would appear that …” is an example of ___.
scenes.say_native: Lug‘at mashqi. Bo‘sh joyga eng mos so‘zni toping: “exacerbate”, “alleviate”, “coherent” yoki “hedging”. Har bir so‘z faqat bir marta ishlatiladi. Gapning umumiy ma’nosiga qarang: yaxshilash yoki yomonlashtirish, mantiq yoki ehtiyotkor ohang.
scenes.say: Fill the gaps with exacerbate, alleviate, coherent, or hedging. Each word is used once. Decide whether each sentence is about making things better or worse, about logic, or about careful tone.
scenes.say_uz: Bo‘sh joylarni exacerbate, alleviate, coherent yoki hedging bilan to‘ldiring. Har bir so‘z bir marta ishlatiladi. Gapning ma’nosiga qarang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: lug‘at
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “exacerbate”, dengiz sathining ko‘tarilishi xavfni oshiradi. Ikkinchi: “alleviate”, og‘riq qoldiruvchi dorilar og‘riqni kamaytiradi. Uchinchi: “coherent”, mantiqli va tartibli dalil. To‘rtinchi: “hedging”, ya’ni fikrni ehtiyotkorlik bilan aytish.
scenes.say: One: exacerbate. Two: alleviate. Three: coherent. Four: hedging. When you learn a new word, always save it inside a full sentence. It stays in memory much longer.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: exacerbate. Ikki: alleviate. Uch: coherent. To‘rt: hedging. Yangi so‘zni doim to‘liq gap ichida saqlang, shunda u xotirada uzoq turadi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: kuchsiz shakllar va bog‘lanish

examples.t: I could have gone.
Pick it up.

scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutqda yordamchi so‘zlar kuchsizlanadi. “Could have” aslida “kudəv” kabi eshitiladi, shuning uchun ko‘pchilik adashib “could of” deb yozadi. Bu xato, to‘g‘risi doim “could have”. Yana bog‘lanish bor: undosh bilan tugagan so‘z unli bilan boshlangan so‘zga ulanadi, “pick it up” esa “pi-ki-tup” eshitiladi.
scenes.say: In natural speech, function words weaken. Could have sounds like could-uv, which is why people wrongly write could of. Words also link: pick it up sounds like pi-ki-tup. In British English, an r can appear between vowels, as in law-r-and order.
scenes.say_uz: Tabiiy nutqda yordamchi so‘zlar kuchsizlanadi. Could have kudəv eshitiladi, lekin could of yozish xato. So‘zlar bog‘lanadi: pick it up pi-ki-tup. Britaniya talaffuzida law and order da r qo‘shiladi.

scenes.title: Britaniya va Amerika varianti
board: BrE: Have you eaten? / AmE: Did you eat?

examples.t: I’ve just eaten. (BrE)
Have you gotten the email? (AmE)

scenes.say_native: Imtihonda ikki variant ham qabul qilinadi, lekin bir matn ichida izchil bo‘lish kerak. Lug‘atda farqlar ko‘p: “flat” va “apartment”, “lift” va “elevator”, “queue” va “line”. Grammatikada amerikaliklar o‘tgan zamonni tez-tez ishlatadi: “Did you eat?”, britaniyaliklar esa ko‘pincha “Have you eaten?”.
scenes.say: Both varieties are acceptable, but be consistent. Flat is British and apartment is American. Lift and elevator, queue and line. British speakers often say Have you eaten? while Americans often say Did you eat? Gotten is American only. And do not mix colour with color in one text.
scenes.say_uz: Ikkala variant ham qabul qilinadi, lekin izchil bo‘ling. Flat britaniyacha, apartment amerikacha. Gotten faqat amerikacha. Bir matnda colour va color aralashmasin.

scenes.title: O‘qish: strategiya

examples.t: Whether this is a genuine loss remains contested.

scenes.say_native: O‘qish topshirig‘ida avval matnni tez ko‘zdan kechirib, asosiy fikrni toping. Keyin bog‘lovchi so‘zlarga qarang: “however”, “yet”, “whereas” fikr burilishini ko‘rsatadi. C2 da ko‘p savol muallifning munosabati haqida: u ma’qullayaptimi, shubhalanyaptimi yoki betarafmi?
scenes.say: Skim first for the main idea. Then notice signposts such as however, yet, and whereas. At C2, many questions are about the writer’s attitude, which tone words reveal. And remember: correct answers often paraphrase the text instead of repeating it.
scenes.say_uz: Avval asosiy fikrni toping. Keyin however, yet, whereas kabi belgilarga e’tibor bering. C2 da muallifning munosabati haqida savollar ko‘p. To‘g‘ri javob ko‘pincha matnning parafrazasi bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: O‘qish matni
scenes.say_native: Hozir qisqa matnni o‘qiyman. Siz ko‘zdan kechirib, so‘ng savollarga javob berasiz. Matnni diqqat bilan eshiting va muallifning ohangini ushlashga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Critics argue that cheap flights have democratised travel. Yet the same affordability, they claim, has eroded the very experience it was meant to broaden: tourists now hop between identical airports, sample identical menus and return with identical photographs. Whether this amounts to a genuine loss, or merely nostalgia for an elite past, remains contested.
scenes.say_uz: Tanqidchilar arzon parvozlar sayohatni hamma uchun ochdi, deydi. Lekin ularning fikricha, shu arzonlik kengaytirmoqchi bo‘lgan tajribaning o‘zini yemirdi: sayyohlar bir xil aeroportlar, bir xil taomlar va bir xil suratlar orasida yuradi. Bu haqiqiy yo‘qotishmi yoki elitar o‘tmishga sog‘inchmi, bahsli.

scenes.title: Vaqtli mashq: o‘qish savollari
board: 2 What do critics say has been lost?
3 Is the writer sure it is a real loss?
scenes.say_native: Endi savollar. Birinchi: “democratised” so‘zi nimani anglatadi? Ikkinchi: tanqidchilarga ko‘ra nima yo‘qolgan? Uchinchi: muallif buni haqiqiy yo‘qotish deb aniq ishonadimi? To‘rtinchi: muallifning ohangi qanday? Matnni qayta ko‘z oldingizga keltiring va qisqa javob bering.
scenes.say: Four questions. What does democratised mean? What do critics say has been lost? Is the writer certain it is a real loss? And what is the writer’s tone? Answer briefly.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Democratised nimani anglatadi? Tanqidchilarga ko‘ra nima yo‘qolgan? Muallif aniq ishonadimi? Muallifning ohangi qanday? Qisqa javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: o‘qish
board: 2 the variety and authenticity of the experience
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: “democratised” oddiy odamlar uchun ochiq qilingan degani. Ikkinchi: tajribaning o‘ziga xosligi va xilma-xilligi, chunki hamma joy bir xil bo‘lib qolgan. Uchinchi: yo‘q, muallif “remains contested” deydi, ya’ni bahsli. To‘rtinchi: ohang muvozanatli, betaraf, chunki ikkala fikr ham keltirilgan va xulosa chiqarilmagan.
scenes.say: One: made available to ordinary people. Two: the variety and authenticity of the experience. Three: No, because the writer says it remains contested. Four: balanced and neutral. Both views are given and no conclusion is drawn.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: oddiy odamlarga ochiq qilingan. Ikki: tajribaning xilma-xilligi va o‘ziga xosligi. Uch: yo‘q, muallif bahsli deydi. To‘rt: muvozanatli, betaraf ohang.

scenes.title: Tinglash: ishxonada suhbat
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash matni ishxonadagi qisqa suhbat. Ikki hamkasb hisobot haqida gaplashadi. Raqamlar va shartga e’tibor bering. Savollarni eshitishdan oldin oxirida beriladi, shuning uchun asosiy ma’lumotlarni ushlashga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Anna: Did you manage to get through the report? Ben: Only half. I’d have finished, but the meeting overran. Anna: Shall I ask Priya to take over the figures? Ben: No, I’d rather keep them. I’ll have them ready by Thursday noon, provided nobody changes the brief. Anna: Fine. I’ll put it in the diary.
scenes.say_uz: Anna: Hisobotni tugata oldingmi? Ben: Faqat yarmini. Yig‘ilish cho‘zilmaganida tugatardim. Anna: Raqamlarni Priyaga topshiraymi? Ben: Yo‘q, o‘zim qoldiraman. Payshanba tushigacha tayyor bo‘ladi, agar hech kim topshiriqni o‘zgartirmasa. Anna: Yaxshi. Kundalikka yozib qo‘yaman.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 1
board: 3 When will the figures be ready?
scenes.say_native: Suhbatni eslang va to‘rt savolga javob bering. Nima uchun Ben ishni tugatmadi? Priyadan so‘rashni kim taklif qildi? Raqamlar qachon tayyor bo‘ladi? Ben qanday shart qo‘ydi? Shart “provided” so‘zidan keyin keldi. Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.
scenes.say: Four questions. Why did Ben not finish? Who offers to ask Priya? When will the figures be ready? And what is Ben’s condition? Remember the word provided.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Ben nega tugatmadi? Priyadan so‘rashni kim taklif qildi? Raqamlar qachon tayyor? Benning sharti nima? Provided so‘zini eslang.

scenes.title: Tinglash javoblari 1
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: yig‘ilish cho‘zilib ketgan, “overran”. Ikkinchi: taklifni Anna qildi, “Shall I ask Priya”. Uchinchi: payshanba tushigacha. To‘rtinchi: hech kim topshiriqni o‘zgartirmasa. “Provided” va “as long as” sharti bildiradi. Bu so‘zlar tinglashda juda muhim: ular ko‘pincha javobning o‘zini yashiradi.
scenes.say: One: the meeting overran. Two: Anna. Three: by Thursday noon. Four: provided nobody changes the brief. Provided means on condition that, and in listening tasks such words often hide the answer.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: yig‘ilish cho‘zildi. Ikki: Anna. Uch: payshanba tushigacha. To‘rt: hech kim topshiriqni o‘zgartirmasa. Provided shart bildiradi va ko‘pincha javobni yashiradi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: mehmonxonada
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash matni mehmonxonadagi suhbat. Mehmon noroziligini bildiradi, xodim esa yechim topishga urinadi. Kim nimani rad etishiga va oxirgi kelishuvga diqqat qiling. Rasmiy ohangni ham sezing.
scenes.say: Reception: Good evening, how may I help? Guest: I booked a sea-view room, but mine overlooks the car park. Reception: I do apologise. Unfortunately we’re fully booked tonight, but I can offer an upgrade tomorrow. Guest: Tomorrow’s no good; I check out at nine. Reception: In that case, let me refund one night’s charge. Guest: That would be acceptable.
scenes.say_uz: Qabulxona: Xayrli kech, qanday yordam bera olaman? Mehmon: Dengiz manzarali xona buyurtma qilgandim, lekin xonam avtoturargohga qaraydi. Qabulxona: Uzr so‘rayman. Afsuski, bugun hamma xona band, ertaga yaxshiroq xona taklif qila olaman. Mehmon: Ertaga to‘g‘ri kelmaydi, soat to‘qqizda ketaman. Qabulxona: Unda bir kechalik to‘lovni qaytaraman. Mehmon: Bu maqbul.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 2
board: 2 Why can’t they move him tonight?
3 Why does he refuse the upgrade?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Mehmon nimadan shikoyat qildi? Nega uni bugun boshqa xonaga ko‘chirib bo‘lmaydi? U nega ertangi yaxshilashni rad etdi? Oxirgi yechim nima bo‘ldi? Javob berishda mehmonning o‘z so‘zlarini emas, ma’nosini ayting.
scenes.say: Four questions. What is the guest’s complaint? Why can they not move him tonight? Why does he refuse the upgrade? And what is the final solution? Answer in your own words.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Mehmon nimadan shikoyat qildi? Nega bugun ko‘chirib bo‘lmaydi? U nega yaxshilashni rad etdi? Oxirgi yechim nima? O‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan javob bering.

scenes.title: Tinglash javoblari 2
board: 1 His room overlooks the car park, not the sea
3 He checks out at nine tomorrow
4 A refund of one night’s charge
scenes.say_native: Birinchi: xonasi dengizga emas, avtoturargohga qaraydi. Ikkinchi: mehmonxona to‘la band. Uchinchi: ertaga soat to‘qqizda ketadi, yaxshiroq xonadan foydalanishga ulgurmaydi. To‘rtinchi: bir kechalik to‘lov qaytariladi. E’tibor bering, qabulxona xodimi “I do apologise” va “let me refund” deb muloyim, rasmiy gapirdi.
scenes.say: One: his room overlooks the car park, not the sea. Two: the hotel is fully booked. Three: he checks out at nine tomorrow. Four: a refund of one night’s charge. Notice the polite, formal tone of the receptionist.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: xonasi avtoturargohga qaraydi. Ikki: mehmonxona to‘la band. Uch: ertaga soat to‘qqizda ketadi. To‘rt: bir kechalik to‘lov qaytariladi. Xodimning muloyim, rasmiy ohangiga e’tibor bering.

scenes.title: Yozish: tuzilma va bog‘lanish

examples.t: Although the plan was expensive, we approved it.
The plan was expensive; nevertheless, we approved it.
examples.uz: Reja qimmat edi, shunday bo‘lsa-da, tasdiqladik.

scenes.say_native: Yozma topshiriqda baholovchi uchta narsaga qaraydi: mazmun, tuzilma va til. Birinchi jumlada fikringizni aniq ayting, asosiy qismda dalillarni bog‘lovchilar bilan ulang, oxirida xulosa qiling. “Although”, “nevertheless”, “consequently” kabi so‘zlar matnni yaxlit qiladi.
scenes.say: Examiners look at content, structure and language. State your point at the start, link your arguments in the body, and conclude clearly. Linkers such as although, nevertheless, and consequently make a text cohesive. In formal writing, avoid contractions, and vary your sentence length.
scenes.say_uz: Baholovchi mazmun, tuzilma va tilga qaraydi. Fikrni boshida ayting, dalillarni bog‘lovchilar bilan ulang, aniq xulosa qiling. Rasmiy yozuvda qisqartma ishlatmang va gap uzunligini almashtiring.

scenes.title: Vaqtli yozma topshiriq
board: “The plan was expensive. We approved it.”
scenes.say_native: Yozma topshiriq. Ikki oddiy gapni bitta rasmiy gapga aylantiring: “The plan was expensive. We approved it.” “Although” bilan boshlang yoki “nevertheless” dan foydalaning. Yoz daftaringizga yozing yoki ovoz chiqarib ayting. Sizda yarim daqiqa.
scenes.say: Combine the two simple sentences into one formal sentence. Begin with although, or use nevertheless. Write it down or say it aloud. You have twenty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki oddiy gapni bitta rasmiy gapga birlashtiring. Although bilan boshlang yoki nevertheless ishlating. Yozing yoki ayting. Yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Yozish: namunaviy javob
board: Although the plan was expensive, we approved it.
The plan was expensive; nevertheless, we approved it.
Expensive though the plan was, we approved it.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javoblar uchta. Birinchisi “Although” bilan, eng oddiy va xavfsiz. Ikkinchisida nuqtali vergul va “nevertheless”, unda “nevertheless” dan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi. Uchinchisi “Expensive though the plan was”, juda adabiy tuzilma, sifat gap boshiga chiqadi. Uchalasi ham to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: Three model answers. Although the plan was expensive, we approved it. The plan was expensive; nevertheless, we approved it. Expensive though the plan was, we approved it. All are correct; choose the form you can control.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta namunaviy javob. Although bilan, nuqtali vergul va nevertheless bilan, hamda Expensive though the plan was. Uchalasi ham to‘g‘ri; o‘zingiz yaxshi ishlata oladiganini tanlang.

scenes.title: Gapirish: strategiya
board: Answer, then extend with a reason
Hedge and paraphrase: What I mean is …
Don’t panic over a missing word

examples.t: What I mean is, it depends on the context.
It’s a kind of … a tool for cutting paper.

scenes.say_native: Og‘zaki imtihonda baholovchi ravonlik, aniqlik va fikr chuqurligiga qaradi. Savolga qisqa javob bering va darrov sabab qo‘shing. Fikringizni yumshatish uchun “I’d say” yoki “It depends” deng. Agar so‘z esingizdan chiqsa, jimlik o‘rniga ta’riflang: “a tool for cutting paper”.
scenes.say: Examiners listen for fluency, accuracy and depth of ideas. Answer briefly, then add a reason. Use hedges such as I’d say or It depends. If you lose a word, paraphrase instead of freezing: a tool for cutting paper. That is a skill, not a failure.
scenes.say_uz: Baholovchi ravonlik, aniqlik va fikr chuqurligini tinglaydi. Qisqa javob bering va sabab qo‘shing. So‘z esingizdan chiqsa, ta’riflang. Bu kamchilik emas, ko‘nikma.

scenes.title: Vaqtli gapirish topshirig‘i
board: Topic: Is learning a language worth the effort?
scenes.say_native: Gapirish topshirig‘i. Mavzu: “Is learning a language worth the effort?” Yigirma soniya gapiring. Tuzilma: fikr, sabab, misol va ehtiyotkor yakun. Masalan, “I’d say yes, because…”, “for instance…”, “though it depends on…”. Hozir boshlang, to‘xtamang!
scenes.say: Speak for twenty seconds. Is learning a language worth the effort? Give an opinion, a reason, an example, and a hedge. Begin now.
scenes.say_uz: Yigirma soniya gapiring. Til o‘rganish mehnatga arzirmi? Fikr, sabab, misol va ehtiyotkor yakun bering. Boshlang.

scenes.title: Gapirish: namunaviy javob

examples.t: I’d say it is, because a language opens doors.
examples.uz: Menimcha arziydi, chunki til eshiklarni ochadi.

examples.t: For instance, I can read books in the original.
examples.uz: Masalan, kitoblarni asl nusxada o‘qiy olaman.

scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: “I’d say it is worth it, because a language opens doors, both professionally and personally. For instance, I can now read books in the original and follow films without subtitles. Though, of course, it depends on how much time one can commit.” Ko‘rdingizmi, fikr, sabab, misol, ehtiyotkor yakun: to‘rtta qadam va yigirma soniya.
scenes.say: A model answer: I’d say it is worth it, because a language opens doors, both professionally and personally. For instance, I can now read books in the original. Though, of course, it depends on how much time one can commit.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javob: menimcha arziydi, chunki til kasbiy va shaxsiy eshiklarni ochadi. Masalan, kitoblarni asl nusxada o‘qiy olaman. Albatta, ajratadigan vaqtga bog‘liq.

scenes.title: C2 dan keyin: keyingi qadamlar
scenes.say_native: C2 dan keyin til o‘rganish tugamaydi, u shaklini o‘zgartiradi. Rasmiy imtihon kerak bo‘lsa, Cambridge C2 Proficiency kabi sertifikatlarga tayyorlanishingiz mumkin. Lekin eng yaxshi usul bu ingliz tilini hayotingizning bir qismiga aylantirish: kitob va uzun maqolalar o‘qish, podkast va ma’ruzalar tinglash, haftasiga kamida bir marta yozish va gapirish.
scenes.say: Learning does not end at C2; it changes shape. If you need a formal qualification, you could prepare for an exam such as Cambridge C2 Proficiency. But the best method is to make English part of your life: read widely, listen to podcasts and lectures, and write and speak every week.
scenes.say_uz: C2 dan keyin o‘rganish tugamaydi, shaklini o‘zgartiradi. Rasmiy sertifikat kerak bo‘lsa, Cambridge C2 Proficiency ga tayyorlanish mumkin. Eng yaxshi usul ingliz tilini hayotingizga kiritish: o‘qing, tinglang, yozing va gapiring.

scenes.title: Bugungi darsning xulosasi
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Strategiya: savolni avval o‘qing, variantlarni saralang, vaqtni bo‘ling. Grammatika: since bilan perfect, artikllar, inversiya, cleft va subjunktiv. Lug‘at: so‘zning ohangi va ehtiyotkor ifodalash. Talaffuz: kuchsiz shakllar va bog‘lanish.
scenes.say: Let us sum up. Strategy: read the question first, eliminate options, budget your time. Grammar: perfect with since, articles, inversion, cleft sentences. Vocabulary: tone and hedging. Sound: weak forms and linking. And all four skills, tested today.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: strategiya, grammatika, lug‘at, talaffuz va to‘rt ko‘nikma. Hammasini bugun amalda sinab ko‘rdingiz.

scenes.title: Tabriklaymiz!
scenes.say_native: Hurmatli o‘quvchi, siz yo‘lni oxirigacha bosib o‘tdingiz. Birinchi darsda alifboni va ismingizni harflab aytishni o‘rgandingiz, bugun esa murakkab inversiya va nozik ohang haqida gaplashyapsiz. Yuz ellik dars, minglab so‘z, son-sanoqsiz mashq. Bu oson bo‘lmadi, lekin siz to‘xtamadingiz. Siz bilan chin dildan faxrlanamiz.
scenes.say: Congratulations! You started with the alphabet and your own name, and today you are discussing inversion and subtle tone. One hundred and fifty lessons, thousands of words, countless exercises. It was not easy, but you did not stop. We are truly proud of you.
scenes.say_uz: Tabriklaymiz! Siz alifbo va ismingizdan boshladingiz, bugun esa inversiya va nozik ohang haqida gaplashyapsiz. Yuz ellik dars, minglab so‘z. Oson bo‘lmadi, lekin to‘xtamadingiz. Sizdan faxrlanamiz.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va xayrlashuv
board: Homework: complete the C2 final exam
Use the strategy: read, eliminate, check
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: C2 yakuniy imtihonini topshiring, ya’ni o‘n beshta savolning hammasiga javob bering. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir savolni o‘qib, ikkita noto‘g‘ri variantni olib tashlab, so‘ng tanlang va oxirida tekshirib chiqing. Agar natija sizni qoniqtirmasa, xatolarni yozib, takrorlang va yana urinib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Your homework is to complete the C2 final exam. Answer all fifteen questions calmly: read, eliminate two options, choose, and check at the end. The course ends here, but your English goes on. Good luck, and thank you for learning with us.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: C2 yakuniy imtihonini topshiring, o‘n beshta savolga ham xotirjam javob bering. Kurs shu yerda tugaydi, lekin sizning inglizchangiz davom etadi. Omad va rahmat.

homework_uz: C2 yakuniy imtihonini topshiring: 15 savolning hammasiga javob bering. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir savolda ikkita noto‘g‘ri variantni olib tashlab tanlang va oxirida javoblarni tekshiring; xatolaringizni daftarga yozib, sabablarini tushuntiring.

quiz.why_uz: “Since” bilan davom etayotgan holat present perfect talab qiladi: have lived.

quiz.q: No sooner had she sat down ___ the phone rang.
quiz.why_uz: “No sooner” faqat “than” bilan keladi; “hardly” esa “when” bilan.
“Honest” da h aytilmaydi, so‘z unli tovush bilan boshlanadi: an.

quiz.q: ___ elderly often need help with technology.
quiz.why_uz: “The” + sifat butun guruhni bildiradi: the elderly.

quiz.q: The deal fell ___ at the last minute.

quiz.why_uz: Obyekt yo‘q: rise – rose – risen. Present perfect uchun risen kerak.

quiz.q: The doctor suggested that he ___ more rest.
quiz.why_uz: “Suggest that” dan keyin fe’lning oddiy shakli keladi (subjunktiv): he get.

quiz.q: ___ the company to fail, hundreds of jobs would be lost.
quiz.why_uz: Rasmiy shartda “if” tushadi va “Were … to” ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: In fast, natural speech, “could have” is usually pronounced as:
quiz.why_uz: “Have” kuchsiz shaklga o‘tadi: /kʊdəv/. Shuning uchun “could of” yozish xato.

quiz.q: Rising sea levels will ___ the risk of flooding.
quiz.why_uz: Exacerbate yomonlashtirish, alleviate esa yengillashtirish ma’nosida.

quiz.q: Which word is typically American, not British?
quiz.why_uz: “Gotten” amerikacha; britaniyachada got. Flat, queue, lift esa britaniyacha.

quiz.q: What is the best first step in a reading multiple-choice task?
options: Translate the whole text into Uzbek
Read the question and underline key words
Spend equal time on every item
quiz.why_uz: Avval savol va kalit so‘zlarni o‘qish matnda kerakli joyni tez topishga yordam beradi.

quiz.q: Which linker shows contrast in formal writing?
quiz.why_uz: Nevertheless qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi; moreover qo‘shadi, consequently natijani ko‘rsatadi.

quiz.q: ___ was the noise that woke the baby, not the thunder.
quiz.why_uz: Cleft gap “It was … that …” shaklida tuziladi va urg‘uni bitta bo‘lakka qaratadi.

quiz.q: I wish I ___ the answer right now.
quiz.why_uz: Hozirgi paytga oid afsus (wish) o‘tgan zamon shaklini oladi: knew.
